strings.<h2>Let It Go, aplicación móvil que busc: Let It Go, a mobile app that aims to change consumer habits so people swap and sell the clothes and books they no longer use.
strings.<p>Este proyecto nace de un intento por: This project was born from an effort to contribute to sustainability and the environment through a circular economy. It starts from the idea of seeing the clothes and books we no longer use not as waste, but as a resource that someone else can swap and reuse.
